pages.title: Frayed Thread
pages.text:
**Goal:** keep Thread as currency, and unravel it only when you need string.\
You need quest rewards, flint-mesh dirt on a Loomframe, or a steward cache.\
Every quest returns a little **Frayed Thread** — scraps of the Loom that still hold.

pages.title: Continue
pages.text:
Unravel one for three string.\
Or keep it: **Kin stalls in Clowder Hall** (`/clowder hub`) sell saplings, buckets, meshes, pearls, and other things a pad runs short of.\
Right-click an Elder.\
**Check:** you can buy a sapling or mesh at a Hall Elder without going broke on string.

pages.title: Codex Pages
pages.text:
**Goal:** read a margin note without spending the page.\
You need a **Codex Page** from seating (every third Strand) or a Hall Kin stall.\
Every third Strand a Clowder seats, a **Codex Page** slips free — a margin note from that tribe. Right-click to read it. Pages are kept, not spent.

pages.title: Continue
pages.text:
Hall Kin stalls at `/clowder hub` sell a few loose ones too. Those pick a tribe on their own.\
**Check:** right-click a page; it stays in your hand.
